analyst.summary: Pearl Global Industries is a global apparel manufacturer and exporter, supplying major international fashion brands from manufacturing bases across India and South Asia. The company is benefiting from a broader shift of global sourcing away from China, and has delivered solid revenue and profit growth with meaningfully improved returns on capital over the past year. The stock has re-rated very sharply over the past two years, reflecting this improved story. We rate it a Hold: a genuinely improving apparel exporter riding a real structural tailwind, but one whose share price has already moved a long way to reflect that.
